svg.text: The building blocks of a CASCADE model
A model is a directed graph: nodes joined by edges. You describe each element with attributes and rules to guide the engine.
tail → head means "the tail provides to the head" (the head depends on the tail).
External stressors: they damage the elements that are vulnerable to them, starting a cascade.
Putting the blocks together — three layers as a network-of-networks
Nodes AND edges carry attributes (names shown going out) and, optionally, rules; edges run within a layer (solid) or across layers (dashed).
